execution.prompt:
Weekly reconcile of the principles record in ~/dev/mmon/concept/docs/principles/ (README.md says what it is and how it is used) against mlegls's answers from the past 7 days.

1. Collect his answers: for each automation in `bb automation list --project proj_fgz6kudzrk`, list runs with `bb automation runs <id> --project proj_fgz6kudzrk`, and read each period thread with `bb thread log <thr> --all`. The first User turn is the automation prompt; later User turns are his, except `[bb system]`, `[task]` and `[bb message …]` notices and messages prefixed "From Concept Engineering". Also grep `git log --since='7 days ago' -p -- docs/issues docs/principles AGENTS.md` for `maintainer` decisions recorded elsewhere.
2. For each answer that rules on a class of cases rather than one item: if a principle already covers it, add the item as an instance link; if it contradicts or refines one, edit the principle and keep his quote; if it's new, add it with his words, the date and an @thread link. Merge two principles that are one rule, and note where a principle is really a mechanism to build (then it belongs in an issue, not here). A principle an agent proposed (marked _Proposed_) becomes confirmed only where he agreed with it in a thread; quote that.
3. Check each confirmed principle still holds against his answers: where he overruled an agent that cited one, the principle needs editing or narrowing.
4. Commit only docs/principles/ (and AGENTS.md if its Principles section changes) on main with `git commit -m … -- <paths>`, after `eval "$(mise env -s bash)"` so the hooks find bun. Other threads leave uncommitted edits in this checkout; never stage or commit them.

Keep it terse: one line per principle plus his words; no narration. Final response: the commit hash, what was added, edited, merged or confirmed (a line each), and any principle his answers now contradict that you couldn't resolve without him, phrased as a numbered question with options and a recommendation. If nothing changed, say so in one line.
